description: This file declares the QemuManager class, which manages QEMU virtual machine instances within the Cuttlefish project. It includes method declarations for configuring graphics and boot devices, starting VM commands, and checking support capabilities.

classes.name: QemuManager
classes.description: A class that manages QEMU virtual machine instances, providing configuration and startup functionalities.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the QemuManager class, which is 'qemu_cli'.

methods.name: QemuManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the QemuManager with a specified architecture.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports QEMU virtualization.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for a specific Cuttlefish instance.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot devices for a specific Cuttlefish instance.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the commands necessary to start a QEMU VM based on the provided configuration.
